title: The Word Mentor
short_teaser: The word mentor comes from a character in Homer’s Odyssey who was trusted to guide Telemachus.
story: The word mentor comes from a character in Homer’s Odyssey who was trusted to guide Telemachus. The name gradually became a general word for a wise and experienced guide. A role can outgrow its original story and become a model for relationship. Words shape what we notice and remember. Naming an experience can make it easier to understand, share, and use. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
